SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL DATA ONLY

This 1,200-row dataset is entirely artificial. It contains no real people or clinical assessments.
The Low/Mild/Moderate/High labels and indicator flags are generated from simple invented rules and random noise.
PTSD-like columns are fictional demonstration labels, not PTSD screening, diagnosis, or validated thresholds.
Use this only to demonstrate file upload, multi-target model training, and sample predictions.
High scores or predicted indicators do not establish a condition, and results must not guide care or treatment.
